#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
repo=$(pwd)
old=/var/tmp/tide-ordering-y8PzxCLV
data="$repo/experimente/17_prioritaeten/messung.json"
tide="$repo/tide"
workbench="$repo/workbench/function_body.tide"
stamp() { perl -MTime::HiRes=clock_gettime,CLOCK_MONOTONIC -e 'printf("%.9f\n",clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC))'; }
prepare() {
  family=$1; rep=$2; arm=$3; tag=$family-$rep-$arm
  oldrun="$old/results/$tag"
  cp "$oldrun/forms" "$root/forms"
  jq -c '.units' "$oldrun/input" > "$root/basis"
  mkdir -p "$root/project"
  find "$root/project" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type f -delete
  cp "$old/seeds/$family/$arm"/*.tide "$root/project/"
  jq -c --arg f "$family" --argjson r "$rep" --arg a "$arm" '.runs[]|select(.family==$f and .repetition==$r and .arm==$a)|.attempts[-1].answer' "$data" > "$root/good"
}
materialize() {
  local payload unit
  payload=$(jq -nc --slurpfile b "$root/basis" --slurpfile f "$root/forms" --slurpfile a "$1" '{files:$b[0],forms:$f[0],edits:$a[0].edits}')
  "$tide" run "$workbench" --call candidate_files --inputs "$payload" > "$root/files"
  for unit in "$root/project"/*.tide; do
    jq -ejr --arg f "${unit##*/}" '.[]|select(.file==$f)|.source' "$root/files" > "$unit"
  done
}
verify() {
  (cd "$root/project" && "$old/$1/$family/verify")
}
proposal() {
  local payload
  payload=$(jq -nc --slurpfile f "$root/files" --slurpfile a "$root/bad" --slurpfile d "$root/diagnostic" '{files:$f[0],edits:$a[0].edits,diagnostic:($d[0]|{file,code,message,line,column})}')
  "$tide" run "$workbench" --call closing_retry --inputs "$payload" > "$root/proposal"
}
retry() {
  outcome=invalid; proposed=false
  materialize "$root/bad"
  if verify control > "$root/red_result" 2> "$root/diagnostic"; then outcome=already_green; return; fi
  if [[ ! -s "$root/diagnostic" ]]; then outcome=public_rejected; return; fi
  proposal
  if ! jq -e 'has("some")' "$root/proposal" >/dev/null; then outcome=no_proposal; return; fi
  proposed=true
  jq -c '{edits:.some}' "$root/proposal" > "$root/corrected"
  materialize "$root/corrected"
  if verify control > "$root/public" 2> "$root/retry_diagnostic"; then
    outcome=passed
  elif [[ -s "$root/retry_diagnostic" ]]; then
    outcome=compiler_rejected
  else
    outcome=public_rejected
  fi
}
canonical_equal() { diff -q <(jq -Sc . "$root/corrected") <(jq -Sc . "$root/good") >/dev/null; }
if [[ "$1" == natural ]]; then
  prepare journal 3 tide-lib
  jq -c '.runs[]|select(.family=="journal" and .repetition==3 and .arm=="tide-lib")|.attempts[0].answer' "$data" > "$root/bad"
  for iteration in {1..12}; do
    start=$(stamp)
    retry
    end=$(stamp)
    [[ "$outcome" == passed ]]
    canonical_equal
    verify holdout > "$root/holdout"
    jq -nc --argjson iteration "$iteration" --argjson start "$start" --argjson end "$end" --slurpfile issue "$root/diagnostic" --slurpfile p "$root/public" --slurpfile h "$root/holdout" '{iteration:$iteration,seconds:($end-$start),start:$start,end:$end,issue:$issue[0],public:$p[0],holdout:$h[0]}' >> "$root/natural.ndjson"
  done
elif [[ "$1" == controls ]]; then
  prepare journal 3 tide-lib
  for fault in missing_operand two_closers extra_closer wrong_type wrong_result; do
    case "$fault" in
     missing_operand) expr="(eq 1";;
     two_closers) expr="(not (not true";;
     extra_closer) expr="(not true))";;
     wrong_type) expr="0";;
     wrong_result) expr="(not true";;
    esac
    jq -c --arg body "$expr" '(.edits[]|select(.name=="earlier").body)=$body' "$root/good" > "$root/bad"
    retry
    if [[ "$fault" == wrong_result ]]; then [[ "$outcome" == public_rejected ]] && jq -e '.failed>0' "$root/public" >/dev/null || exit 7
    else
      [[ "$outcome" == compiler_rejected || "$outcome" == no_proposal ]]
      (cd "$root/project" && ! "$tide" check summary.tide >/dev/null 2>"$root/still_red")
    fi
    jq -nc --arg fault "$fault" --arg body "$expr" --argjson proposed "$proposed" --arg outcome "$outcome" --slurpfile issue "$root/diagnostic" --argjson final "$(if [[ "$outcome" == public_rejected ]]; then cat "$root/public"; else cat "$root/still_red"; fi)" '{fault:$fault,body:$body,offered:$proposed,outcome:$outcome,issue:$issue[0],final:$final}' >> "$root/controls.ndjson"
  done
elif [[ "$1" == campaign ]]; then
  while read -r f i a; do
    prepare "$f" "$i" "$a"
    materialize "$root/good"
    verify control > "$root/public"
    verify holdout > "$root/holdout"
    jq -nc --arg run "$tag" --slurpfile p "$root/public" --slurpfile h "$root/holdout" '{run:$run,public:$p[0],holdout:$h[0]}' >> "$root/unchanged.ndjson"
    while read -r target; do
      jq -c --arg t "$target" '(.edits[] | select(.name==$t).body) |= .[0:-1]' "$root/good" > "$root/bad"
      retry
      [[ "$outcome" == passed ]]
      canonical_equal
      verify holdout > "$root/holdout"
      jq -nc --arg run "$tag" --arg target "$target" --arg hash "$(jq -cS . "$root/bad" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" --slurpfile issue "$root/diagnostic" --slurpfile p "$root/public" --slurpfile h "$root/holdout" '{run:$run,target:$target,edit_set_sha256:$hash,edits_match:true,issue:$issue[0],public:$p[0],holdout:$h[0]}' >> "$root/mutations.ndjson"
    done < <(jq -r '.edits[] | select((.body|startswith("(")) and (.body|endswith(")")))|.name' "$root/good")
  done < <(jq -r '.runs[]|select(.arm|startswith("tide-"))|[.family,.repetition,.arm]|@tsv' "$data")
fi

use sequence

record Progress
prior:?{Event} breaks:i current:i longest:i

advance state_value:{Progress} incoming:{Event} > {Progress}
(let backward (case (get prior state_value) false previous (earlier incoming previous)) (let count (if backward 1 (+ (get current state_value) 1)) (let peak (get longest state_value) (make Progress prior (some incoming) breaks (+ (get breaks state_value) (if backward 1 0)) current count longest (if (> count peak) count peak)))))

use ordering

use streak

record Report
breaks:i longest:i

journal events:*{Event} > {Report}
let empty make Progress prior (nil {Event}) breaks 0 current 0 longest 0
let state_value fold events empty totals row item advance totals item
make Report breaks (get breaks state_value) longest (get longest state_value)

main batches:**{Event} > *{Report}
fold batches (list {Report} 0) reports row batch append reports (journal batch)
